title: PLUGGED DAILY DISCIPLINE TRACKS
style: ambient electronic meditation, timed to breath cycles, gentle male voice guidance NZ/AU accent, soft drone bass, sparse clean production, each phrase timed to inhale and exhale, warm and grounding, no sudden sounds, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 60 BPM
lyrics:
``
[INTRO — timed to breath, spoken]
Breathe in.
Four counts.
Hold.
Four counts.
Out.
Four counts.
This is the first discipline.
Every culture found it.

[VERSE 1 — calm, guided]
Prana in the Indian tradition
Chi in the Chinese way
Box breath in the battle
Zazen watching night and day

The smoke curls up in ceremony
The hongi shares the life
The Wim Hof cold and steady
Cuts through like a knife

[CHORUS — gentle but powerful]
Breath before the word
Breath before the thought
Breath is the one discipline
Every culture ever taught
In — hold — out — hold
The body knows before the mind
Breath is the transformation layer
Between the lost and what you find

[VERSE 2]
Michelle breathing through the Spanish
Wesley cooling down his game
Ruby finding flow in fashion
All arriving just the same

One breath before you type it
One breath before you send
One breath — the A.I. waits for you
The human leads — not the machine

[OUTRO — slowing, returning to silence]
Breathe in.
This moment.
Breathe out.
Let it go.
The discipline begins here.
Every. Single. Day.
